selection_rule: The first ten available training-season match IDs, ascending. First five development, next five held out. Selection uses IDs and required second-half coverage, never model scores or tactical findings.
expected: Independent raw-JSON counts/rates/concentration for core metrics; exact claim field reconciliation; every evidence reference resolves. False-premise answers must test metrics and retain the no-causality qualification. Unsupported and malformed questions must be refused before analytical reporting.
review: Machine checks and author-written expectations only; independent human semantic review remains pending. Local-generation success is counted only when local_selection mode was used, never from fallback.
local_generation: Compare deterministic reports with digest-pinned Qwen3 claim selection on the same cases. At most one repair. Store rejection rate, repair count, input/output tokens and latency separately from deterministic numerical correctness.
